neighbouring_grade_review: Under the Bavarian G9 LehrplanPLUS and BayGSO Anlage 1, Geography is not taught in Grades 8 or 9 (only Grades 5, 7, 10, 11). The older de-by Grade 8 (tropics, trade winds, deserts, Sahel desertification) and Grade 9 (HDI, disparities, demography, megacities) cells map to G8 curricula whose core themes now sit in Grade 10 (LB 2, 3, 5, 6, 7). Thomas is asked whether both legacy cells should be formally included in this Grade 10 mapping.

Combines the 5-phase demographic transition model, age pyramids, push/pull migration and megacities across different curriculum areas.
